title: A New Dawn
summary:
Venezuela has a bright future, but challenges remain
Things can change quickly in the oil markets. A few weeks ago, on December 12, 2025, we wrote a Tanker Opinion entitled "Pirates Of The Caribbean?", discussing President Trump's maximum pressure campaign against his Venezuelan counterpart, Nicolas Maduro. Now, Maduro is in custody in New York, and the United States is "running" Venezuela and its oil industry.
